notes.title: V1.5 Is Out Now! Share Your Levels Online, Achievements and More!
notes.content:
Version 1.5 of Chaotic Workshop is out now with a number of big features and improvements! Read below for the full change notes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33172961/6a4c8bf55d1d24958c3548c48bc3bb73d7171dda.png

Community Levels!
Want to share your awesome blueprint puzzle with others? Looking to test your problem solving skills against others creations?!

Community Levels are now available! Jump into the sandbox, create an amazing level and share it with the rest of the Chaotic Community Online and for others to play it! Do you want to see what others have made? You can now download levels created and shared by others across different platforms!

With that said, Steam Workshop is now unsupported. This way other players on other platforms can all share and play community made creations! 

Achievements
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33172961/ad32c04028e202c39b90a4f3878fbc5fb2a4c6a8.png
Chaotic Workshop now has a list of Achievements to challenge you to accomplish! Not sure what there is to do? Check out the Achievements board in the new Play Profile section!

Quality of Life
I've done a pass on the entire game, streamlining different areas and features, fixing bugs and updating it to the latest engine! It should now run smoother on OSX and Linux as well as improved Steam Deck support!

Thanks Again!
Thank you again for playing my game. Chaotic Workshop is currently a solo-dev effort by Virtex Edge. If you like what you see or have some feedback, let me know in the Virtex Discord!

notes.title: New Mod SDK, New Items, and New Steam Winter Sale!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33172961/dd312b6300f8df9b092ff9f48337b9d01d667b98.png
We've released a new Mod SDK, new Items along with a revamped UI and to celebrate the holidays, Chaotic Workshop is on Sale on Steam! 

Read below for more information!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33172961/7be7a3a3a3d38045dc3adebb09f8ed27c9ca606b.png
After a lot of work, we're proud to announce Mod Support for The Chaotic Workshop! Create your own items and levels and pack them as a plugin dll file! Download our Visual Studio Sample and SDK from Github here and get started!!!


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33172961/9b2ac768d302436a04047bc0a19d3336b852b5aa.png
We've added a number of new items for the sandbox such as:

Anti-Grav Field
Cupcake Cannon
RC Car
Grenades
Propane Tank
And much more...!

You can find a full change log breakdown on our blog here.

notes.title: Join the Chaos! Join the Beta!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/ccG0PQD.png

Join the Chaos!
In lead up to our Launch on Steam, We're running a closed Beta for The Chaotic Workshop later this Summer! Sign up below to be included in the Beta!

New levels, new entities, and the long awaited ability to upload your Blueprints online to the Chaotic Cloud, there's a lot coming to The Chaotic Workshop and would love your feedback!

 REGIST NOW!
